notes.title: We are live!
notes.content:
And we are live! Who will be able to complete all 100 levels first? Tell us in our Discord when you've completed all the levels!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45417066/fe85412f7cedd73cac62abfb7c96f2d4a4689bb9.gif[/img]


Have fun puzzle solving and if you find any bugs or issues please report them in our discord under #lab-escape-discussion

notes.title: Release Date Annoucement!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce the Steam Release Date of Lab Escape!

Lab Escape will be available to play on April 17th, just a week from now!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45417066/b5ab910501fc7b6c5de786993207e9d53b5d742d.png[/img]

A major milestone for us, but just the beginning of what we have have in store for you all!

If you are too impatient, go and try out the free demo or even our other puzzle game on Steam - Walkbot! (https://store.steampowered.com/app/2062630/WalkBot/)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45417066/66d34431a070a021c4c1da00b44f2abb58bdf7fd.png[/img]

notes.title: We are in the Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Exciting News, Puzzle Lovers!

Lab Escape: Box Puzzle Game is part of Steam Next Fest: February 2025! 🎉 That means you can play the demo, solve mind-bending puzzles, and meet our adorable lab rats before the full release!

Get ready for magnets, lasers, and 100 unique puzzles that will test your wits!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3496920
